description: Read mail delivered to an inbox from create_inbox, newest first, for example a verification code or confirmation link from a signup email. Returns immediately; mail usually arrives within seconds, so an empty result can be checked again shortly. format="html" returns each message's HTML for reviewing the email's design.

format.description: "text" (default) returns each message flattened to readable text, with link targets kept. "html" returns the raw HTML part.

name: check_inbox
